chapter_title: KYC — Chapter I: Preliminary
atomic_requirement: Cl. 1 Short Title & Commencement: Called the KYC Directions, 2016; effective from date of publication on RBI's website.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter I: Preliminary
atomic_requirement: Cl. 2 Applicability: Applies to all RBI-regulated entities (REs), including foreign branches/subsidiaries, subject to local law.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter I: Preliminary
atomic_requirement: Cl. 3 Definitions: Terms take meaning from PMLA 2002 and PML Rules unless defined otherwise; several amendments (2023, 2025).

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter II: General
atomic_requirement: Cl. 4 KYC Policy: Board (or delegated committee) must approve a KYC policy; groups need group-wide AML policies.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter II: General
atomic_requirement: Cl. 5 KYC Policy Elements: Must cover Customer Acceptance Policy, Risk Management, CDD/CIP, and Transaction Monitoring; REs must periodically assess ML/TF risk across clients, geographies, products, and delivery channels.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter II: General
atomic_requirement: Cl. 6 Designated Director: Board-nominated person accountable for PMLA compliance; details reported to FIU- IND.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter II: General
atomic_requirement: Cl. 7 Principal Officer: Responsible for compliance, transaction monitoring, and regulatory reporting; details reported to FIU-IND.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter II: General
atomic_requirement: Cl. 8 Compliance of KYC Policy: Requires defined Senior Management roles and clear allocation of implementation responsibility.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter III: Customer Acceptance Policy
atomic_requirement: Cl. 9 CAP Requirement: REs must frame a Customer Acceptance Policy (see source for sub-clauses).

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter III: Customer Acceptance Policy
atomic_requirement: Cl. 10 CAP Content: No anonymous/benami accounts; no account if CDD can't be completed due to non- cooperation or unreliable info.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter III: Customer Acceptance Policy
atomic_requirement: Cl. 11 Non-Discrimination: CAP must not deny banking access to disadvantaged groups, incl. PwDs; no rejection without reasoned review.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter IV: Risk Management
atomic_requirement: Cl. 12 Risk-Based Approach: Customers categorized low/medium/high risk based on identity, financial status, business nature, geography, and product/channel risk.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter V: Customer Identification Procedure (CIP)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 13 When ID Required: At account opening and for non-account-holder international money transfers.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter V: Customer Identification Procedure (CIP)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 14 Third-Party CDD Reliance: REs may rely on third-party CDD (incl. via CKYCR) for transactions ≥₹50,000 or account opening, subject to conditions.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter V: Customer Identification Procedure (CIP)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 16 Individual CDD: Requires Aadhaar (or offline verification/OVD) and PAN/Form 60 for account-based relationships and for BOs/signatories/POA holders.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter V: Customer Identification Procedure (CIP)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 17 Aadhaar OTP e-KYC: Non-face-to-face onboarding allowed with explicit OTP consent; alerts sent only to Aadhaar-registered mobile; board policy needed for mobile-number change requests; deposit balance caps apply.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter V: Customer Identification Procedure (CIP)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 18 V-CIP: Permitted for onboarding individuals, proprietors, authorised signatories, and BOs of legal entities; proprietorship also needs activity proof documents.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter V: Customer Identification Procedure (CIP)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 23 Small Accounts: Alternative to full CDD; annual credit cap of ₹1 lakh plus other limitations.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter V: Customer Identification Procedure (CIP)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 24 Simplified NBFC Accounts: NBFCs may open accounts without standard docs if self-attested photo obtained and designated officer certifies signature/thumb impression.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter V: Customer Identification Procedure (CIP)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 26 KYC Portability: Prior branch-verified KYC is valid on transfer to another branch of the same RE if not due for periodic update.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter V: Customer Identification Procedure (CIP)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 27 Sole Proprietorship CDD: Individual (proprietor) CDD required; plus any two (or, if genuinely unavailable, one, with contact-point verification) business-proof documents.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter V: Customer Identification Procedure (CIP)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 28 Sole Proprietorship CDD: Individual (proprietor) CDD required; plus any two (or, if genuinely unavailable, one, with contact-point verification) business-proof documents.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter V: Customer Identification Procedure (CIP)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 29 Sole Proprietorship CDD: Individual (proprietor) CDD required; plus any two (or, if genuinely unavailable, one, with contact-point verification) business-proof documents.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter V: Customer Identification Procedure (CIP)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 30 Company Accounts: Requires incorporation certificate, MOA/AOA, company PAN, and board resolution/POA for authorised signatories.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter V: Customer Identification Procedure (CIP)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 31 Partnership Accounts: Requires registration certificate, partnership deed, firm PAN, BO/authorised-person documents, partner names, and business address.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter V: Customer Identification Procedure (CIP)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 32 Trust Accounts: Requires registration certificate, trust deed, PAN/Form 60, BO/authorised-person documents, and names of beneficiaries/trustees/settlor/protector.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter V: Customer Identification Procedure (CIP)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 34 Legal Person BO Identification: BO identification required; exemption for listed entities/their subsidiaries meeting specified conditions.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter V: Customer Identification Procedure (CIP)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 35 Ongoing Due Diligence: Transactions must be checked against customer profile, business, and source of funds/wealth.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter V: Customer Identification Procedure (CIP)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 36 Monitored Transaction Types: Includes large/complex transactions (e.g., RTGS) and those inconsistent with expected activity.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter V: Customer Identification Procedure (CIP)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 37 Risk-Based Monitoring: Risk categorization reviewed at least every six months; MLM company accounts need close monitoring.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter V: Customer Identification Procedure (CIP)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 38 Periodic KYC Updation: Risk-based; at minimum every 2 years (high risk), 8 years (medium), 10 years (low).

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter VI: Simplified KYC Procedures
atomic_requirement: Cl. 39 PAN/Form 60 for Existing Customers: Must be obtained by notified date; failure triggers temporary account freeze.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter VI: Simplified KYC Procedures
atomic_requirement: Cl. 40 EDD for Non-Face-to-Face Onboarding: Applies to digital (CKYCR, DigiLocker, e-documents) and non- digital (NRI/PIO certified OVD) channels.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter VI: Simplified KYC Procedures
atomic_requirement: Cl. 41 PEP Accounts: Allowed with enhanced due diligence — risk systems to flag PEPs, source-of-funds checks, senior-management approval, and ongoing monitoring.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter VI: Simplified KYC Procedures
atomic_requirement: Cl. 42 Professional Intermediary Client Accounts: Client identification required when intermediary opens account for a single client.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter VI: Simplified KYC Procedures
atomic_requirement: Cl. 43 SHG Simplified Norms: Full member CDD not required at account opening; office-bearer CDD sufficient; member CDD may occur at credit-linking stage.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter VI: Simplified KYC Procedures
atomic_requirement: Cl. 44 Foreign Student Accounts: NRO account may be opened using passport, visa/immigration endorsement, photo, and admission letter.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter VII: Record Management
atomic_requirement: Cl. 45 FPI Simplified KYC: SEBI-registered FPIs onboarded per Annex IV documents, subject to FATCA/CRS rules and an undertaking for exempted documents.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter VII: Record Management
atomic_requirement: Cl. 46 Record Retention: Transaction records kept ≥5 years from transaction date; identification/address records kept ≥5 years after relationship ends.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter VII: Record Management
atomic_requirement: Cl. 47 Reporting Obligation: REs must furnish PML Rules-mandated information to FIU-IND Director.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter VII: Record Management
atomic_requirement: Cl. 48 Reporting Formats/Tools: Use FIU-IND prescribed formats and CTR/STR utilities.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter VIII: Reporting to FIU-IND
atomic_requirement: Cl. 49 Reporting Delays: Each day of delay/misreporting is a separate violation; STR filing alone must not restrict account operations.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter VIII: Reporting to FIU-IND
atomic_requirement: Cl. 50 Alert Systems: REs need software generating alerts for transactions inconsistent with risk profile.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter VIII: Reporting to FIU-IND
atomic_requirement: Cl. 51 UAPA Obligations: No accounts for individuals/entities on UNSC terrorist-link lists under Section 51A UAPA.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter VIII: Reporting to FIU-IND
atomic_requirement: Cl. 52 WMD Act Obligations: Compliance with WMD Act 2005 procedures per Sept 2023 Finance Ministry order.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter VIII: Reporting to FIU-IND
atomic_requirement: Cl. 53 UNSCR 1718 List: Daily verification against the DPRK sanctions list.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter VIII: Reporting to FIU-IND
atomic_requirement: Cl. 54 High-Risk Jurisdictions: REs must consider FATF statements on non-compliant jurisdictions.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter X: Other Instructions & Compliance
atomic_requirement: Cl. 55 Secrecy Obligations: Customer info confidential; not shared for cross-selling without customer consent.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter X: Other Instructions & Compliance
atomic_requirement: Cl. 56 CKYCR Sharing: CERSAI authorised as CKYCR; REs share/upload CDD data accordingly.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter X: Other Instructions & Compliance
atomic_requirement: Cl. 57 FATCA/CRS Reporting: REs assess Reporting FI status under IT Rules 114F–114H and register/report accordingly.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter X: Other Instructions & Compliance
atomic_requirement: Cl. 58 Instrument Presentation Period: Cheques/drafts/pay orders invalid for payment beyond 3 months from issue.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter X: Other Instructions & Compliance
atomic_requirement: Cl. 59 Money Mule Prevention: Diligence and monitoring required to prevent accounts being used as money mules.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter X: Other Instructions & Compliance
atomic_requirement: Cl. 60 Account Payee Cheque Collection: Restricted to the named payee, with a narrow co-operative credit society exception (≤₹50,000).

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter X: Other Instructions & Compliance
atomic_requirement: Cl. 61 UCIC: Unique Customer Identification Code required for individual customers; optional for occasional walk- ins unless they transact frequently.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter X: Other Instructions & Compliance
atomic_requirement: Cl. 62 New Technology Risk: REs must assess ML/TF risk from new products, delivery channels, and technologies.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter X: Other Instructions & Compliance
atomic_requirement: Cl. 63 Correspondent Banking: Board-approved policy needed for cross-border correspondent relationships.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter X: Other Instructions & Compliance
atomic_requirement: Cl. 64 Wire Transfers: Cross-border wire transfers require complete originator/beneficiary details (name, account, address/ID, etc.).

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter X: Other Instructions & Compliance
atomic_requirement: Cl. 65 Demand Drafts etc.: Instruments ≥₹50,000 must be issued by debit to account/cheque, not cash; purchaser's name shown on the instrument.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter X: Other Instructions & Compliance
atomic_requirement: Cl. 66 PAN Quoting: PAN (or Form 60) required and verified per Income Tax Rule 114B.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter X: Other Instructions & Compliance
atomic_requirement: Cl. 67 Third-Party Product Sales: Walk-in customer ID verification for sales >₹50,000; records maintained per

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter X: Other Instructions & Compliance
atomic_requirement: Cl. 68 At-Par Cheque Facility: Arrangements with co-operative banks monitored for credit/reputational risk; banks retain audit rights.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter X: Other Instructions & Compliance
atomic_requirement: Cl. 69 PPI Issuance: Must follow RBI's PPI Master Direction.

chapter_title: KYC — Chapter X: Other Instructions & Compliance
atomic_requirement: Cl. 70 Employee Screening/Training: Know-Your-Employee screening and ongoing AML/CFT training required.

chapter_title: Payment Data Localization Mandate
atomic_requirement: Cl. 2 Data Localization Mandate: System providers, their vendors/intermediaries, and other ecosystem entities must store payment system data in India to ensure RBI supervisory access.

chapter_title: IT Governance & Cyber Resilience Framework
atomic_requirement: Cl. 3 Legal Basis: Issued under Section 10(2) read with Section 18 of the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007. 3. IT Governance — RBI (IT Governance, Risk, Controls and Assurance Practices) Directions, 2023

chapter_title: IT Governance & Cyber Resilience Framework
atomic_requirement:
Cl. 32 Interpretation clause.

chapter_title: Cyber Resilience & Payment Security (Non-Bank PSOs)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 3 Phased Implementation: Large PSOs by Apr 1 2025; Medium by Apr 1 2026; Small by Apr 1 2028.

chapter_title: Cyber Resilience & Payment Security (Non-Bank PSOs)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 4 Applicability: All authorised non-bank PSOs.

chapter_title: Cyber Resilience & Payment Security (Non-Bank PSOs)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 5 Third-Party/Unregulated Entity Coverage: PSOs must extend these standards (via board-approved policy) to unregulated ecosystem partners, subject to mutual agreement.

chapter_title: Cyber Resilience & Payment Security (Non-Bank PSOs)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 6 Objective: Strengthen payment-system safety through cyber resilience. Section II – Governance Controls

chapter_title: Cyber Resilience & Payment Security (Non-Bank PSOs)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 14 Inventory Management: Maintain asset/process/vendor inventory and network/data-flow diagrams.

chapter_title: Cyber Resilience & Payment Security (Non-Bank PSOs)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 15 Identity & Access Management: Access-privilege policies; digital identity assigned and monitored per individual.

chapter_title: Cyber Resilience & Payment Security (Non-Bank PSOs)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 16 Network Security: Periodic device security checks; SOC for centralized monitoring; automated detection tools.

chapter_title: Cyber Resilience & Payment Security (Non-Bank PSOs)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 17 Application Security Life Cycle: Secure-by-design/S-SDLC approach; multi-tier architecture with DB-layer segregation.

chapter_title: Cyber Resilience & Payment Security (Non-Bank PSOs)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 18 Security Testing: Annual (minimum) code review/VA/PT by qualified professionals; vendor certification if code not owned by PSO.

chapter_title: Cyber Resilience & Payment Security (Non-Bank PSOs)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 19 Vendor Risk Management: Follow RBI's Outsourcing Framework (Aug 2021); controls to prevent vendor- network infiltration.

chapter_title: Cyber Resilience & Payment Security (Non-Bank PSOs)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 20 Data Security: Data-leak prevention policy covering data in transit/at rest, incl. at vendor sites; traceability mechanisms.

chapter_title: Cyber Resilience & Payment Security (Non-Bank PSOs)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 21 Patch & Change Management: Documented patching policy with defined timeframes.

chapter_title: Cyber Resilience & Payment Security (Non-Bank PSOs)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 22 Incident Response: Board-approved mechanism to notify management, staff, and regulators of cyber incidents.

chapter_title: Cyber Resilience & Payment Security (Non-Bank PSOs)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 23 Business Continuity Plan: Scenario-based BCP, reviewed annually, with incident/recovery playbook.

chapter_title: Cyber Resilience & Payment Security (Non-Bank PSOs)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 24 API Security: Authentication/authorisation, confidentiality, integrity, and availability controls for APIs.

chapter_title: Cyber Resilience & Payment Security (Non-Bank PSOs)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 25 Employee Awareness/Training: Periodic training and awareness evaluation for staff and vendors.

chapter_title: Cyber Resilience & Payment Security (Non-Bank PSOs)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 26 Cloud Security: Board-approved cloud policy covering CSP roles, data localisation, and recoverability.

chapter_title: Cyber Resilience & Payment Security (Non-Bank PSOs)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 27 Other Security Measures: MFA mandatory for electronic debit transactions; secure IT infrastructure configuration. Section IV – Specific Digital Payment Security Controls

chapter_title: Cyber Resilience & Payment Security (Non-Bank PSOs)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 28 Alert Mechanisms: Online alerts based on failed transactions, velocity, geo/IP anomalies, behavioral biometrics, etc.

chapter_title: Cyber Resilience & Payment Security (Non-Bank PSOs)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 29 Customer Notifications: Mask sensitive account/card data in alerts; show merchant name (not gateway) and amount.

chapter_title: Cyber Resilience & Payment Security (Non-Bank PSOs)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 30 Fraud-Flagging Facility: App/website feature for customers to mark fraudulent transactions instantly.

chapter_title: Cyber Resilience & Payment Security (Non-Bank PSOs)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 31 Mobile Payment Security: Anomaly-free apps; maintain encrypted session integrity throughout interactions.

chapter_title: Cyber Resilience & Payment Security (Non-Bank PSOs)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 32 Terminal Validation: Card-capture terminals validated under PCI-P2PE; PIN-entry PoS terminals under PCI-PTS.

chapter_title: Cyber Resilience & Payment Security (Non-Bank PSOs)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 33 Transaction Limits: Card networks to enable limits at card/BIN/issuer level.

chapter_title: Cyber Resilience & Payment Security (Non-Bank PSOs)
atomic_requirement: Cl. 34 Vernacular Alerts: PPI issuers encouraged to send OTP/alerts in customers' preferred language.

chapter_title: Reserve Bank Integrated Ombudsman Scheme
atomic_requirement: Cl. 35 PPI Cooling Period: Mandatory cooling period before fund transfer/cash withdrawal after electronic loading. 5. Grievance Redressal — RB-IOS 2021 (Reserve Bank Integrated Ombudsman Scheme)

chapter_title: Reserve Bank Integrated Ombudsman Scheme
atomic_requirement: Cl. 1 Complaint Admissibility Conditions: 1. A written complaint must first be made to the concerned Regulated Entity. 2. The Ombudsman complaint is admissible only if the RE rejected it (wholly/partly) and the complainant is dissatisfied, or the RE gave no reply within 30 days. 3. Must be filed within 1 year of the RE's reply (or 1 year + 30 days if no reply received). 4. Not admissible if it concerns the same cause of action already covered elsewhere (remainder of conditions in source text).
